d.g: A human double-stranded DNA virus of the species JC polyomavirus, causing progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy and other diseases in immunodeficient patients.

JC virus.e: After the patient, John Cunningham, in whom ZuRhein and Chou identified this virus in 1965 by electron microscopy.
